_comment: Per-plugin ceilings for the skill listing, in characters. Regenerate with scripts/check_listing_budget.py --update, and say in the commit why a ceiling went up. The runtime default below is characters standing in for tokens: this library measures 4.63 characters per token, so 8,000 is about 1,728 tokens against the 2,000 that one per cent of a 200k window allows.
